exposure: Cesarean hysterectomy for suspected morbidly adherent placenta
cohort: A single patient with three prior cesarean deliveries, anterior placenta previa, and a fundal fibroid who underwent cesarean hysterectomy for suspected morbidly adherent placenta.
finding: An incidental leiomyosarcoma (LMS) was identified on final pathology after cesarean hysterectomy for suspected morbidly adherent placenta.
mod_finding: An incidental leiomyosarcoma was found after a cesarean hysterectomy.
